steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); const rows = snapshot.modelCalls ?? []; const views = snapshot.roleRoutes ?? []; const extraction = rt.getGlobalSettings().extraction; const llm = rows.filter((row) => row.kind === 'llm'); const audits = llm.filter((row) => row.role.startsWith('read:') && row.route === null); if (!audits.length) throw new Error(`no shared-read audit row after a real turn: ${JSON.stringify(rows)}`); const routedReads = llm.filter((row) => row.role.startsWith('read:') && row.route !== null); if (!routedReads.length) throw new Error(`no routed read row: the call that answered the shared read recorded no route (v2.6 plan 04 H4): ${JSON.stringify(rows)}`); const expected = (row) => { const role = row.role.split(':')[0]; const view = views.find((entry) => entry.role === role); return String(row.result).startsWith('fallback from') ? (extraction.fallbackProfileId ?? null) : (view?.profileId ?? null); }; const wrong = llm.filter((row) => row.route !== null && row.route !== expected(row)).map((row) => ({ ...row, expected: expected(row) })); if (wrong.length) throw new Error(`an LLM row names a route its role does not resolve to: ${JSON.stringify(wrong)}`); const judges = rows.filter((row) => row.kind === 'judge'); const bad = judges.filter((row) => (row.route !== null ? !row.route.startsWith('judge:typesafe:') : !row.result.startsWith('fallback'))); if (bad.length) throw new Error(`judge rows with a wrong route: ${JSON.stringify(bad)}`); return { audits: audits.length, routedReads: routedReads.map((row) => row.route), judges: judges.length };

const events = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge'); const missing = events.filter((event) => !('route' in (event.detail ?? {}))); if (missing.length) throw new Error(`judge journal events without a route field: ${missing.length}`); return { judgeEvents: events.length };
